# VALOREA MARKET

> Premier Swiss-engineered institutional B2B physical commodities brokerage platform and supervised clearing exchange headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.

VALOREA MARKET connects verified sovereign buyers, qualified refiners, industrial distributors, and accredited producers across physical commodity transactions through audited bilateral KYC/KYB screening, end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) deal rooms, and internationally recognized ICC banking instruments.

## Core Capabilities & Specialization

- **Physical Commodity Sectors**:
  - **Energy & Hydrocarbons**: Light Sweet & Heavy Sour Crude Oil, Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel (EN590 10 ppm), Aviation Kerosene (Jet Fuel A1 / Colonial Grade 54), Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG).
  - **Fertilizers & Nutrients**: Granular Urea 46% (Prilled / Granular), NPK Formulations, Diammonium Phosphate (DAP), Muriate of Potash (MOP).
  - **Metals & Mining**: Electrolytic Copper Cathodes (Grade A 99.99% purity, LME standard), Primary Aluminium Ingots (A7/A8), Battery-grade Lithium Carbonate & Hydroxide, Gold Bullion (LBMA Good Delivery).
  - **Petrochemicals**: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE), Polypropylene (PP), PET Resins.
  - **Agricultural Staples**: Milling Wheat (Grade 1 & 2), Refined White Cane Sugar (ICUMSA 45), Raw Cane Sugar (ICUMSA 600-1200), Non-GMO Yellow Corn.

- **Regulatory & Compliance Architecture**:
  - **Sanctions & AML Screening**: Real-time bilateral verification against OFAC (US Treasury), EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions, SECO (Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs), and UN Security Council watchlists.
  - **Broker Protection & Anti-Circumvention**: Automated digital Non-Circumvention Non-Disclosure Agreements (NCNDA) and Irrevocable Master Fee Protection Agreements (IMFPA) compliant with ICC 400/500/600 provisions.
  - **E2EE Deal Rooms**: Private WebRTC and document vaults with anti-leak watermarking, verbal audio moderation, and biometric identity verification for principals and mandated intermediaries.

- **Standard Banking & Payment Instruments**:
  - Irrevocable, Transferable / Non-Transferable Documentary Letters of Credit (DLC MT700) governed by UCP 600.
  - Standby Letters of Credit (SBLC MT760) governed by ISP98 / URDG 758.
  - Bank Wire Telegraphic Transfer (TT MT103 / MT202) released upon SGS / Intertek inspection report at loading or discharge port.
  - Standard Incoterms 2020: CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight), FOB (Free on Board), CFR (Cost and Freight).

## Key Public Resources

- [Official Portal](https://valoreamarket.com/): Multilingual physical exchange portal (8 supported languages: Arabic, English, French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, German, Russian).
- [Commodity Catalog](https://valoreamarket.com/en/catalog): Live verified listings, technical specifications, and available allocation volumes.
- [Institutional FAQ](https://valoreamarket.com/en/faq): Direct answers to compliance, KYC/KYB, banking procedures, and deal room access.
- [About the Exchange](https://valoreamarket.com/en/about): Corporate governance, Swiss desk location, and operational principles.
- [Brokerage & NCNDA Governance](https://valoreamarket.com/en/legal/ncnda): Legal frameworks protecting mandates and managing fee distribution.
- [Contact Trading Desk](https://valoreamarket.com/en/contact): Direct institutional desk coordinates at Rue du Rhône 42, Geneva, Switzerland.
